paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: compress tool output, cut up to 20% of context, without touching the contex
A slim port of Headroom. Compresses tool output and cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the
model's context cache or agent performance.
A tool run leaves a long log / JSON / diff. Only a small part of it is useful. This plugin shortens
that output before the next turn, keeps the original on disk, leaves the already-sent prefix alone s
o the cache stays valid, and gives the agent a tool to pull the full context back.
